content:
The intention is that all review is conducted by AI. Each new PR will receive independent reviews according to each of the rubrics in https://github.com/FormalFrontier/TauCetiReview/tree/main/rubrics.

I didn't put a lot of time into the rubrics, but they are not looking so bad so far. I would be interested in having criticism and improvements to the rubrics, but ideally we can be data-driven here (see "evaluation of review" at #Tau Ceti > Possible next steps @ 💬, ideally we should be doing A/B testing of rubric changes)!

How can you contribute here?

  • First and foremost, help run review agents! See #Tau Ceti > Getting started: the `tauceti` CLI
  • Donate tokens and/or money to help run review agents... (Happy to discuss in DMs, and loop in @Johan Commelin at the Mathlib Initiative and @Leonardo de Moura at the Lean FRO as appropriate.)
  • Help work out how we can evaluate the reviews (see "evaluation of review" at #Tau Ceti > Possible next steps @ 💬, ideally we should be doing A/B testing)
  • Suggest improvements to the review rubrics: these are just initial drafts, although appear to be holding up well. My experience is that lengthy instructions are not super helpful with current frontier models.
